nearFrontierPolicy.basis: Public rounded integer Intelligence Index and two-decimal USD total cost from the chart tooltips. The frontier's intelligence at a point's cost is the highest intelligence among rendered-frontier points whose cost is at or below that cost; a point cheaper than every frontier point has no gap.
nearFrontierPolicy.text: A plotted configuration is near-frontier when it lies within 3 Intelligence Index points of the rendered frontier at its cost. Every near-frontier model family must be in the primary ranking, with its own selected configuration, or be explicitly deferred with a dated, reasoned roster decision. The cost ratio to the cheapest frontier point of equal or higher intelligence is reported for information only.
